topics.title: 课程作业
topics.summary: 每项考核说明须明确生成式 AI 许可范围；禁用例外须说明理由并经学院教育委员会批准。
topics.scope: 考核与反馈守则第 3.10、4 节及附录二量表。

claims.text: Each assessment brief specifies permitted GenAI use. A prohibition exception needs reasons and School Education Committee approval.

evidence.quote:
3.10 Staff must make a deliberate decision as to which type of GenAI use students are permitted to
     use in assessment (Annex 2) and be able to justify the rationale for usage. If students are not
     permitted to use GenAI in assessment, the rationale must be provided to students, and this
     exception must be approved by School Education Committee.
evidence.title: Assessment and Feedback Code of Practice 2025
evidence.location: Assessment Code section 3.10; physical PDF page 4

topics.evidenceScope: Assessment and Feedback Code sections 3.10 and 4, with the scale in Annex 2.

topics.title: 考试
topics.summary: 考试 AI 规则须看该项考核说明；内置拼写、语法辅助的默认许可不含考试和课堂测试，另有说明除外。
topics.scope: 书面考核辅助工具许可不代表允许生成考试答案。

claims.text: Use the assessment brief for the actual exam’s AI rules. Default permission for built-in spelling/grammar assistance excludes examinations and class tests, unless advised otherwise.

evidence.quote:
4.2   All students must be permitted to use assistive AI tools to check spelling, grammar and
      punctuation (i.e., use of in-built spell checkers) in all written assessments excluding
      examinations and class tests, unless advised otherwise.
evidence.title: Assessment and Feedback Code of Practice 2025
evidence.location: Assessment Code section 4.2; physical PDF page 5; physical PDF page 5

topics.evidenceGap: The written-assessment assistive-tool permission is not permission to generate exam answers. Use the assessment brief for the actual exam’s AI rules. Default permission for built-in spelling/grammar assistance excludes examinations and class tests, unless advised otherwise.
topics.evidenceScope: The written-assessment assistive-tool permission is not permission to generate exam answers.

topics.title: 披露
topics.summary: 学生须披露并正确引用 AI 使用，教职员工应提醒学生遵守。
topics.scope: 教育框架第 3.2.4 节及具体考核说明。

claims.text: Students must disclose and properly cite AI use; staff should remind them of these requirements.

evidence.quote:
3.2.4 Staff should remind students that they must disclose when AI tools have been used in
their work, that they require proper citation and refer them to the Academic Misconduct
Code of Practice
evidence.title: Generative AI in Education Framework (2025)
evidence.location: Framework section 3.2.4; physical PDF page 3; physical PDF page 3

topics.evidenceScope: Framework section 3.2.4 and the specific assessment instructions.

topics.title: 隐私与数据
topics.summary: 不得要求学生向非 Keele 生成式 AI 系统上传个人数据；师生不得向生成式 AI 工具上传受版权保护内容。
topics.scope: 考核与反馈守则第 4.6–4.8 节，保留对象和系统范围。

claims.text: Students must not be required to upload personal data to non-Keele GenAI systems. Staff and students must not upload copyright-protected content to GenAI tools.

evidence.quote:
4.6   Students must not be required to upload personal data to non-Keele tools and systems that use
      GenAI as part of an assessment as this may compromise students’ intellectual property and
      personal data rights.

4.7   Staff must not submit student work to non-Keele tools and systems that use GenAI detection
      software or use non-Keele GenAI tools to check the authenticity of student work as this may
      compromise students’ intellectual property and personal data rights.

4.8   Staff and students must not upload copyright protected content to GenAI tools.
evidence.title: Assessment and Feedback Code of Practice 2025
evidence.location: Assessment Code sections 4.6–4.8; physical PDF page 6; physical PDF page 6

topics.evidenceScope: Assessment and Feedback Code sections 4.6–4.8; preserve audience and system limits.

topics.title: 机构工具
topics.summary: Microsoft Copilot 是师生通过 Keele IT 账户使用、无额外个人收费的机构工具。
topics.scope: 机构访问范围；考核许可与实际账户开通须分别确认。

claims.text: Microsoft Copilot is the institutional tool available without a separate charge to staff and students through Keele IT accounts.

evidence.quote:
3.4.3 Staﬀ should make students aware that AI is already integrated into the key tools used
by the university; for example, Microsoft Oﬃce 365 deploys AI in email and PowerPoint and
AI is embedded into the KLE along with other third-party tools that the university uses for
teaching and learning. Microsoft Copilot is the institutional tool available free to staﬀ and
students as part of the MS Oﬃce 365 suite. Use of other AI tools must consider accessibility
and equitable access along with GDPR and data privacy.
evidence.title: Generative AI in Education Framework (2025)
evidence.location: Framework section 3.4.3; physical PDF page 5; physical PDF page 5

topics.evidenceScope: Institutional access; each assessment’s permission and actual account activation remain separate.

topics.title: 研究与发表
topics.summary: 本次教育框架不足以确定完整科研、学位论文或期刊发表 AI 政策。
topics.scope: 科研专属署名、披露和数据批准仍有证据缺口。
topics.evidenceGap: Research-specific authorship, disclosure and data approvals remain evidence gaps. The reviewed education framework does not establish a complete research, thesis or journal-publication AI policy.
topics.evidenceScope: Research-specific authorship, disclosure and data approvals remain evidence gaps.

additionalTopics.title: 学术诚信
additionalTopics.summary: 涉嫌考核生成式 AI 误用按抄袭类别处理，而非代写类别；申诉期限算法及收件人描述的差异仍未解决。
additionalTopics.scope: 考核守则第 4.9 节及违规、申诉来源；不编造统一期限。

claims.text: Suspected GenAI misuse in assessment follows the plagiarism category, rather than contract cheating. Conflicting appeal timing and recipient descriptions remain unresolved.

evidence.quote:
4.9   Where staff have concerns that GenAI has been misused in an assessment, this is considered
      under the category of plagiarism (not contract cheating), and staff should follow procedures for
      reporting suspected academic misconduct.
evidence.title: Assessment and Feedback Code of Practice 2025
evidence.location: Assessment Code section 4.9; physical PDF page 6; physical PDF page 6

additionalTopics.evidenceScope: Assessment Code section 4.9 and misconduct/appeal sources; do not invent a unified deadline.

additionalTopics.title: 教学指导

additionalTopics.scope: 考核守则第 4.5–4.7 节；不扩大成禁止所有获批校内检测或比对系统。
